name: daily_to_invincible_player

handedness.characterLeft: viewer-right; produces and holds the game cartridge
handedness.characterRight: viewer-left; exposes and swipes the glove control strip

frames.description: Daily form, visor on head, both hands relaxed.
Left hand draws the game cartridge; right forearm begins to rise.
Left hand holds the cartridge upright at chest height; right glove control strip faces inward.
Right hand begins a clear horizontal swipe across its glove; cartridge remains steady.
Swipe trail reaches the end; glove and cartridge light up cyan to magenta.
Activation flash reaches the face; angular star visor starts forming; wing roots light.
Star visor locks; light wings and segmented tail form; cartridge dissolves into pixels.
Light wings fan open while both arms begin to settle.
Complete Invincible Player form, full light wings and tail, hands lowered naturally.

exitAnimation: short pixel dissolve back to daily form; do not reverse the cartridge action
